movie_title: Why is Super Mario so popular? - 6 Minute English
introduction: Improve your English vocabulary and listening in just six minutes! The famous video game character S
lead_intro: Join us in exploring the fascinating world of video games and iconic characters like Super Mario! Test your knowledge with our quiz below.

quiz.question: What was the first game in which Mario made his appearance?
quiz.explanation: Mario first appeared in the game Donkey Kong, not The Legend of Zelda or Pokemon.

quiz.question: What term was used by Keza Macdonald to describe a large number of games coming out in a short period of time?
quiz.explanation: Keza Macdonald used the term 'flood of' to describe a large number of games coming out in a short period of time.

quiz.question: How did Keza Macdonald describe games from 35 years ago that are not possible to play now?
quiz.explanation: Keza Macdonald mentioned that some games from 35 years ago are unplayable, meaning they are not possible to play now.

quiz.question: What term was used to describe something that can't be played or a game that is difficult to enjoy?
quiz.explanation: 'Unplayable' describes something that can't be played or a game that is difficult to enjoy.

quiz.question: What term means that the quality or standards of something hasn't changed and still looks good or plays well?
quiz.explanation: 'Holds up' means that the quality or standards of something haven't changed and still look good or play well.
